description: Register a ChargebeeResource wrapping the Chargebee API v2. HTTP Basic auth (api_key as username, blank password). Chargebee uses POST for every mutating operation (create AND update) -- create is POST /customers, update is POST /customers/{id}. Exposes a generic request().

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var with the Chargebee API key.

name: Chargebee Resource
